_README: Human decisions. The builder reads this file and never writes to it.
Everything here is applied after extraction, on every run, so a
correction made once stays made. To fix something the extractor got
wrong, edit this file -- never catalog_cocktails.json or
sample_network.json, which the next run overwrites.
drop_person          extracted 'people' that are topics, roles or fragments
drop_organization    extracted 'companies' that are concepts or fragments
rename_person        fold a misspelling or variant into the real name
person_org           set a person's employer by hand; beats every guess
hosts_only           episodes Juan and Tim recorded alone, by exact title
hosts_only_patterns  regexes for the recurring host-only formats
Entries under _unresolved are NOT applied. They are open questions.

_unresolved._note: Decisions I could not make for you. Move an entry up into the real key above once you have decided, or delete it.
